content.value_statement: DevOps work often spans pipelines, infrastructure, deployments, and operations. This skill gives Claude and Claude Code structured guidance for CI/CD, Terraform-style scaffolding, and deployment reviews.
actual_capabilities: Explains CI/CD pipeline patterns and common quality gates.
Provides local Python scripts that analyze a target path and emit JSON reports.
Documents infrastructure as code practices and review considerations.
Summarizes deployment strategy topics for Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms.
Guides users through setup, quality checks, and troubleshooting references.
limitations: The included scripts are placeholder analyzers and do not generate full production pipelines.
It does not connect to cloud accounts or deploy infrastructure by itself.
Reference guides contain generic examples that need project-specific adaptation.
Users must validate generated recommendations against their security and compliance rules.

use_cases.title: Plan a new CI/CD workflow
use_cases.description: Ask for a delivery pipeline outline with build, test, scan, and deployment stages.

use_cases.title: Review deployment readiness
use_cases.description: Use the skill to check release steps, rollback planning, and operational risks before launch.

use_cases.title: Create infrastructure guidance
use_cases.description: Draft project-specific infrastructure as code practices from the included reference material.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the DevOps options
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the senior-devops skill to explain which CI/CD and deployment practices fit this project. Keep the answer beginner friendly.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a pipeline plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the senior-devops skill to design a CI/CD pipeline for this repository, including build, test, security checks, and deployment stages.

prompt_templates.title: Review release readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the senior-devops skill to review our deployment process and identify missing rollback, monitoring, or approval steps.

prompt_templates.title: Compare infrastructure approaches
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the senior-devops skill to compare Terraform, Kubernetes manifests, and managed platform options for this service. Include risks and tradeoffs.

output_examples.input: Design a CI/CD pipeline for a Node.js API.
output: Recommended stages: install, lint, test, build, scan, package, deploy.
Include branch protections, artifact retention, and rollback notes.
Add environment-specific approval gates before production.

output_examples.input: Check whether our deployment process is production ready.
output: The review highlights rollback gaps, missing health checks, and incomplete monitoring ownership.
It recommends release gates, smoke tests, and a documented incident path.

output_examples.input: Create guidance for Terraform module structure.
output_examples.output: The skill suggests separating reusable modules from environment configuration, documenting inputs, and validating plans before apply.

best_practices: Provide repository context, deployment targets, and current tooling before asking for recommendations.
Review generated guidance with platform, security, and application owners before applying it.
Run changes in a staging environment before using them for production deployments.
anti_patterns: Do not run deployment commands from examples without adapting them to your environment.
Do not treat generic reference guidance as a complete compliance review.
Do not store secrets in generated files or committed environment files.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy applications automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and local scripts, but users must execute and approve deployment actions.

faq.question: Can it create production Terraform modules?
faq.answer: It can guide module structure, but the included script is a simple analyzer and not a full module generator.

faq.question: Which tools does it mention?
faq.answer: It references Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, CircleCI, AWS, GCP, and Azure.

faq.question: Is it suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes, if users ask for explanations and review the guidance before running commands.

faq.question: Can Claude Code use this skill with a repository?
faq.answer: Yes. Claude Code can use it to reason about DevOps workflows and inspect local project context.

faq.question: Does it handle secrets safely?
faq.answer: The skill does not exfiltrate secrets, but users should avoid placing real secrets in generated or committed files.
